response.sql:
WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean
  FROM per_rating
  WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT p.rating,
       p.avg_ratio AS avg_rate_per_day,
       p.avg_ratio - o.overall_mean AS diff_above_overall_mean
FROM per_rating p
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL
  AND p.avg_ratio > o.overall_mean;

assumptions.assumption: Ratings are the 5 film.rating values; per-rating groups are formed only from films with replacement_cost > 20.99 (so a rating with no such films does not appear and is not counted in the overall mean).
The overall mean is the unweighted mean of per-rating averages (not weighted by film count), as the request states.
rental_rate / rental_duration is computed per film as a decimal (not integer) division, then averaged.
